answer: An agent economy can require each account to lock a scarce, slashable deposit before it may submit jobs or claim rewards. A verifier checks signed work and randomly samples completed tasks; if an account’s output is fraudulent, its deposit is burned and honest participants receive part of it. Creating many identities does not multiply influence without multiplying locked capital, so a sybil swarm raises the attacker’s exposure with every account. The jetty can host a crystal ledger, while a whisper of collusion still risks forfeiture.
